steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the code it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card: exact signatures for the new src/pm/today.cljs, the estate :today block, the pm.core wiring points (name the functions you hook), the pm.ui card and win card with their placement numbers, numbered test cases with hand-checked expected values, and a who-touches-what table (builder: src/pm/today.cljs, src/pm/core.cljs, src/pm/ui.cljs, resources/estate.edn's new :today block, resources/content/hal-lines.edn's new :day-won entry only; tester: new test/pm/today_test.cljs, only adding tests; le-docteur: a TASKS.md row F-1 for the final project's win loop). Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying, then write {run}/builder-notes.md as the quest's Done-when says.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). Check in particular: pm.today is pure (now passed in, no js/Date, no atoms); the tutorial's practice jump and rock can't tick goals; builds real at load don't count; the checkboxes can't be clicked to fake a goal; the win shows once; ?fresh clears pm.today.v1; it works with DEMO true and no bridge; no person, pet or member named in code; no npm deps. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Make only the documentation edits the spec's who-touches-what table gives le-docteur (if none, change nothing). Reply with git diff --stat of what you changed.
